sources.entry: atelier by Ethan Yucetepe - Claude Code plugin with eight design-automation skills driven by one schema-validated brand.json: design tokens for CSS, Tailwind, TypeScript and Figma, social cards, favicon and app-icon sets, responsive AVIF and WebP images, HTML-to-video recording, a WCAG 2.1 AA audit, and a runtime UX audit covering bfcache, INP, dialogs and mobile viewports.

summary.one_liner: A Claude Code plugin that generates design assets (tokens, social cards, icons, responsive images, HTML-to-video) from one schema-validated brand.json and runs WCAG and runtime UX audits on a page.
summary.what_it_does: atelier keeps a single .atelier/brand.json file as the source for design outputs. Its design-token skill writes tokens.css, tailwind.config.js, tokens.d.ts and Figma variables. The og-card-generator makes 1200x630 PNG social cards per page, and brand-asset-pipeline produces favicons, app icons, social covers and Steam capsules. The responsive-image-pipeline outputs AVIF and WebP at 480 to 1920px with LQIP placeholders, and html-to-video records pages to MP4 or WebM. Two audits check the shipped page: accessibility-design-audit runs a WCAG 2.1 AA check, and runtime-ux-audit runs 65 rules across transitions, INP, panels and mobile, with an optional Chromium dynamic pass. Each skill is also a Node module and CLI, and the repo can run as a GitHub Action.
use_cases: generate design tokens for CSS, Tailwind and TypeScript
create social share cards for blog posts
make favicons and app icons from one logo
convert site images to responsive AVIF and WebP
record a web page as a short MP4 or WebM clip
check a page against WCAG AA accessibility
audit a site for mobile and interaction problems in CI
how_to_run: /atelier-doctor checks Node, dependencies, Chromium, ffmpeg and your brand file
npx playwright@ install chromium (needed for browser skills; /atelier-doctor prints the exact command)
npm install && npm run setup:browsers && npm test (for development)
notable: One brand.json file drives token, card, icon, image and video outputs
runtime-ux-audit with 65 static and optional dynamic rules, including bfcache, INP and mobile viewport checks
Exit codes 0, 1, 2 for clean, critical/serious findings, or could not run, usable as CI gate
Ships as a GitHub Action (EthanY33/atelier@v1) that appends reports to the job summary
Every skill is also a plain Node module and CLI
caveats: Browser-based skills need a one-time Playwright Chromium install, and html-to-video needs ffmpeg on PATH
Requires Node.js 22 or newer and Claude Code with plugin support
Dynamic UX audit is opt-in (--dynamic) and loads pages in Chromium with throttling, so it is slower
